entities.name: Filipe Neri Ferrão
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Filipe Neri António Sebastião do Rosário Ferrão is an Indian Catholic prelate who has served as Archbishop of Goa and Daman since 2004. He was previously an auxiliary bishop of the same archdiocese from 1993 to 2004. Ferrão was created a cardinal by Pope Francis in 2022.
